==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|folwer}}, {{m|enm|folwere}}, {{m|enm|folewer}}, from {{inh|en|ang|folgere|t=follower; attendant; disciple}}, equivalent to {{affix|en|follow|-er|id2=agent noun}}. Cognate with {{cog|stq|Foulger}}, {{cog|fy|folger}}, {{cog|nl|volger}}, {{cog|de|Folger}}, {{cog|sv|följare}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɒləʊə(ɹ)/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-follower.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|literally}} One who [[follow]]s, comes after another.
# Something that comes after another thing.
# One who is a part of [[master]]'s physical group, such as a [[servant]] or [[retainer]].
# {{senseid|en|adherer; disciple}} One who follows mentally, [[adherer]] to the opinions, ideas or teachings of another, a movement etc.
#: {{syn|en|adherent#Noun|disciple#Noun}}
# An [[imitator]], who follows another's [[example]].
# A [[pursuer]].
# {{lb|en|social media}} An [[account]] holder who [[subscribe]]s to see [[content]] from another account on a [[social media]] platform.
#: {{cot|en|followee}}
#: {{ux|en|I have over 50 '''followers''' on Twitter, but all my tweets only get 10 likes.}}
#* {{quote-song|en|year=2012|title=Amen|album=Dreamchasers 2|artist=w:Meek Mill|feat={{w|Drake (musician)|Drake}}|passage=Talking bout these other rappers getting old is even getting old / Worrying about your '''followers''', you need to get your dollars up}}
#* {{RQ:Time|title=Who Is Balendra Shah, the Rapper On Track to Become Nepal’s Next Prime Minister|date=March 11 2026|author=Chad de Guzman
|text=Shah won over the Nepali youth vote with his outsized social media presence. His Instagram account has over 1.2 million '''followers''', while his Facebook page has 3.8 million.
|url=https://time.com/article/2026/03/11/balendra-shah-elections-nepal-prime-minister-rsp-gen-z-protests/
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260311233009/https://time.com/article/2026/03/11/balendra-shah-elections-nepal-prime-minister-rsp-gen-z-protests/}}
# A machine part receiving motion from another.
## {{senseid|en|Q1719345}} A [[tappet#English:_Q1719345|tappet]].
# A man courting a [[maidservant]]; a [[suitor]].
# Young [[cattle]].
# A metal piece placed at the top of a candle to keep the wax melting evenly.
# {{lb|en|Australian rules football}} Any of the three players (the [[ruckman]], [[ruck rover]], and [[rover]]) who usually follow the ball around the ground rather than occupying a fixed position.
# {{lb|en|colloquial|dated}} A [[debt collector]].
# {{lb|en|[[locksmithing]]}} A tool used to remove the core from a pin-tumbler lock without causing the driver pins and springs to fall out.
